title: Fix the Average Calculator
description: The program should calculate the average of two numbers. Fix the bug.
buggyCode:
a = 10
b = 20
average = a + b / 2
print(average)
expectedBehavior: The program should print the average of a and b, which is 15.0.
actualProblem: Because / has higher precedence than +, the code computes a + (b / 2) instead of (a + b) / 2, giving the wrong result.
explanation: Python evaluates operators according to standard precedence rules, so division happens before addition unless parentheses force a different order. Wrapping (a + b) in parentheses ensures the sum is computed first.
